text: The subject Nimra Qadir holds account PK**MEZN****9210 which was opened on 9 January 2021. The declared occupation is Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 May 2026 to 30 May 2026 the account recorded 16 credits totalling PKR 24,648,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 22,647,000. The activity comprised 15 cash deposits totalling PKR 24,498,000 across four branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 30 May 2026, with the STR-PK-01 typology scoring 320 against a threshold of 300. Thirteen of the fifteen cash deposits (87%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, i.e., just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, which is indicative of structuring. The cash deposits were made at four different branches, suggesting a pattern of spreading deposits across locations consistent with structuring. A single day, 22 May 2026, saw more than one cash deposit, a red flag aligned with structuring indicators. Credits in the window were 164.3 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, a cash volume inconsistent with the stated earnings and supportive of structuring suspicion. Overall, the pattern of numerous near‑threshold cash deposits across multiple branches, occasional same‑day multiple deposits, and a total cash volume far exceeding the declared income of PKR 150,000 per month is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 11,807,000 was transferred to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in three transactions. PKR 10,840,000 was transferred to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in three transactions. Debits amounted to 92% of credits, with a median of 28.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit, indicating rapid payout of funds. Screening on 28 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, politically exposed persons or adverse media. On 28 May 2026 the account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending a reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
